scripts.build: prisma generate --schema prisma/schema-postgresql.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema-sqlite.prisma && tsc --build --force && npm run copy-generated
scripts.copy-generated: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function safeCopy(src,dest){try{fs.copyFileSync(src,dest)}catch(e){if(e&&(['EBUSY','EPERM'].includes(e.code))){console.warn('[copy-generated] skip locked:',dest)}else{throw e}}}function copyDir(src,dest){fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const file of fs.readdirSync(src)){const s=path.join(src,file);const d=path.join(dest,file);if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){copyDir(s,d)}else{safeCopy(s,d)}}}copyDir('src/generated/client','dist/src/generated/client');copyDir('src/generated/client-sqlite','dist/src/generated/client-sqlite');"
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --schema prisma/schema-postgresql.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema-sqlite.prisma
